detail:
Full summary: Added read-only raw-file route (/api/raw, root-jailed, text/plain+nosniff), /api/repo-info render-time remote link derivation, repo-path linkification, and a needs-human filter toggle to the Triage dashboard. Spec §8 amended; 22 new tests; 1423 green.
Decisions: Chose render-time link derivation (local /api/raw link authoritative + best-effort remote blob link from /api/repo-info) over a URL-rewrite operation on stored entries — records are immutable audit trail; the approval-time transition to a canonical URL is the resolver relates_to post, which drains the need and preserves what was true at each moment; Chose an undifferentiated 404 for every raw-route deny reason (traversal, dotted segment, symlink escape, missing) and text/plain+nosniff for ALL content — no path-probing signal, and repo HTML can never execute in the dashboard origin; Chose a lookbehind boundary guard in the repo-path regex after a test caught '.twining/config.yml' tail-matching as 'twining/config.yml' — mid-token matches must not linkify
Findings: warning: /api/raw serves any non-dotted repo file as plain text to anyone who can reach the dashboard port — same trust model as the rest of the localhost dashboard, but worth remembering if the dashboard ever grows remote exposure
summary: Added read-only raw-file route (/api/raw, root-jailed, text/plain+nosniff), /api/repo-info render-time remote link derivation, repo-path linkification, and a needs-human filter toggle to the Triage…
